name: novelWriter
title: novelWriter: free Scrivener alternative
hook: Scrivener charges you sixty bucks to write and plan your novel. This app does it for free.

features.say: Break your novel into chapters and scenes, then drag them into any order.
Tag your characters and locations, and see the whole outline at a glance.
When you're done, export to Word, PDF or Open Document.

caption:
Scrivener charges $59.99 to write and plan your novel. novelWriter does it for free ✍️

✅ Split your novel into chapters and scenes, drag them into any order
✅ Tag characters and locations, see the whole outline at a glance
✅ Export to Word, PDF or Open Document
✅ No subscription, no paywall, 100% free

💻 Windows · Linux · Mac (via Python)
ℹ️ novelWriter is a plain text editor with simple Markdown-style markup, not a rich-text word processor. On Mac there's no installer right now, you install it with Python. $59.99 is Scrivener's one-time Standard licence
